periods.label: Freya steers Denatus away from Bell's secret

status.denatus_role: Attends despite no member of her own familia requiring a new title

appearance.overview: An elegant silver-haired goddess whose smile immediately alters the mood of the gods' meeting.

personality.summary: Composed, manipulative, and protective of her own interest in Bell; she uses social pressure and plausible reasoning to shut down Loki's interrogation.
desires: keep Bell from being exposed to every god
preserve her own ability to watch him

decision_pattern.intervention: Frames her preference as respect for familia privacy and lets other gods follow her lead.

quote_samples: 既然赫斯缇雅都说没有违规了，那就没有必要硬逼人家说吧？
既然要取，就替他取个可爱的外号吧？

mannerisms: leans back calmly while others panic
tucks silver hair behind her ear
habits.daily_routine: Appears at Denatus when Bell's status is at stake.
quirks: can make the room follow a suggestion with a single smile

background.pre_story: Her familia's Minotaur incident is linked to earlier upper-floor rumors, and she is watching Bell.

relationships.bell-cranel: Object of interest; she protects his privacy at Denatus while keeping her motives hidden.
relationships.hestia: Helps Hestia deflect scrutiny, leaving Hestia confused and suspicious.
relationships.loki: Outmaneuvers Loki verbally by implying jealousy over Ais's broken record.
relationships.ishtar: Rival beauty goddess who probes her involvement in the Minotaur incident.

knowledge: Knows enough about Bell's Minotaur encounters to propose a plausible explanation for his rapid level-up
secrets: Her true motive for defending Bell is not stated openly.
periods.summary: Freya attends Denatus without her own naming business, defuses Loki's attempt to uncover Bell's secret, frames Bell's Minotaur victory as plausible level-up experience, and instructs the gods to give Bell a cute title before leaving.

key_events.summary: Freya protects Bell's status privacy and persuades the gods to stop pressing Hestia.
